description: Defines a template class 'interval' representing numeric intervals with various operations such as overlap, containment, union, intersection, and conversion. Includes formatting support for printing intervals.

classes.name: interval
classes.description: Template class representing a numeric interval with configurable closed/open end and tag.

methods.name: interval
methods.description: Default constructor initializing interval to empty.

methods.name: interval
methods.description: Constructor with start and stop points, with assertions.

methods.name: start_and_len
methods.description: Creates an interval from start point and length.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Returns the start of the interval.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Returns the end of the interval.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the interval is empty.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the interval.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets start and stop points of the interval.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends the interval by a specified length.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the interval to a new length.

methods.name: displace_by
methods.description: Displaces the interval by an offset.

methods.name: displace_to
methods.description: Moves the start to a specified point.

methods.name: overlaps
methods.description: Checks if this interval overlaps with another.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a point or interval is contained within this interval.

methods.name: intersect
methods.description: Computes intersection with another interval.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a point within the interval bounds.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Comparison based on start point and length.

methods.name: operator|
methods.description: Union of two intervals.

methods.name: operator&
methods.description: Intersection of two intervals.

methods.name: convert_to
methods.description: Converts interval to another interval type with same bounds.

methods.name: right_closed
methods.description: Indicates if interval is right-closed.
